args.summary: After the v2.3.1 deploy, checkout-api began failing health checks across all production regions with an 18% error rate. Rolled back to the most recent release that was healthy in production, v2.3.0. All regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now running v2.3.0, health checks are passing, and error rate is back down to 0.2%. Recommend investigating the v2.3.1 changes before attempting a re-deploy.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was unhealthy in all production regions (18% error rate). The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Health checks now pass and the error rate dropped to 0.2%.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api documenting the failed deploy, the rollback, and the recovery — the on-call engineer has been paged, with a note to investigate v2.3.1 before any re-deploy.
